selected_evidence.requirement: Convert Latin-1 filenames to UTF-8 while retaining structure and contents
selected_evidence.summary: Raw source bytes and inventory establish ISO-8859-1. Both converted filenames validate as UTF-8 and their SHA-256 hashes match their sources before and after restart.
All three imported files retained their original paths and SHA-256 hashes throughout the migration and restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Report collisions without overwriting or silently dropping a source
selected_evidence.summary: converted/plain.txt retained its original hash 6b7244… while imported/plain.txt retained its distinct hash 0e1140…. The collision report records both paths and the preservation action; error count is zero.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 were unchanged before and after migration and restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 192f6cab-c39d-4e64-a3f6-50e677966ca2; native safe restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to b9056c36-3466-490d-8e96-4582b88d2581. System state returned to running with zero failed units, and all migrated data and collision evidence persisted.

commands.command:
set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/filename-encoding-migration
bash -s <<'ANTRIEB_MIGRATE'
set -u
src_root=imported
dst_root=converted
report=conversion-collisions.txt
tmp_report="${report}.tmp"
: > "$tmp_report"
converted_count=0
collision_count=0
error_count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do
  rel=${src#"$src_root"/}
  utf8_rel=$(printf '%s' "$rel" | iconv -f ISO-8859-1 -t UTF-8) || { printf 'ERROR source=%q reason=encoding\n' "$src" >> "$tmp_report"; error_count=$((error_count + 1)); continue; }
  dst="$dst_root/$utf8_rel"
  parent=${dst%/*}
  if [ -e "$dst" ] || [ -L "$dst" ]; then
    printf 'COLLISION source=%q destination=%q action=preserved-existing-destination-and-source\n' "$src" "$dst" | tee -a "$tmp_report"
    collision_count=$((collision_count + 1))
    continue
  fi
  if ! mkdir -p -- "$parent"; then
    printf 'ERROR source=%q destination=%q reason=cannot-create-parent\n' "$src" "$dst" | tee -a "$tmp_report"
    error_count=$((error_count + 1))
    continue
  fi
  if cp -p -- "$src" "$dst"; then
    printf 'CONVERTED source=%q destination=%q\n' "$src" "$dst"
    converted_count=$((converted_count + 1))
  else
    printf 'ERROR source=%q destination=%q reason=copy-failed\n' "$src" "$dst" | tee -a "$tmp_report"
    error_count=$((error_count + 1))
  fi
done < <(find "$src_root" -type f -print0)
mv -f -- "$tmp_report" "$report"
printf 'SUMMARY converted=%d collisions=%d errors=%d report=%q\n' "$converted_count" "$collision_count" "$error_count" "$report"
[ "$error_count" -eq 0 ]
ANTRIEB_MIGRATE
